files.html:
CNPC Real Armor 0.1.0

Initial release for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 and CustomNPCs 1.20.1.

Added

  • Added vanilla-style armor damage reduction for CustomNPCs NPC armor slots.
  • Added optional armor toughness support.
  • Added optional Protection enchantment support.
  • Added optional armor knockback resistance support.
  • Added configurable CustomNPCs resistance and vanilla armor calculation order.
  • Added optional companion armor override.
  • Added optional split NPC armor damage for humanoid EntityCustomNpc NPCs.
  • Added head, chest, and legs hit regions:
  • Head uses helmet armor.
  • Chest uses chestplate armor.
  • Legs use leggings and boots.
  • Added optional armor durability damage.
  • Added in-game debug damage messages.
  • Added Forge Mods menu config screen.
